edges.relationship: Synopsys IP licensed/resold to Gaonchips under an IP OEM partnership for its custom-ASIC projects

contracts.signal: Gaonchips' half-year report (filed 08-14-2026) lists a Synopsys IP OEM partnership signed 2024-02 in its corporate history. IP is Gaonchips' only raw-material line: H1 2026 IP purchases KRW 2,220M domestic + KRW 1,896M imported (FY2025: KRW 7,901M + KRW 2,182M; FY2024: KRW 9,215M + KRW 7,980M). The filing does not break out the Synopsys share.
contracts.units: IP licensing for custom ASIC projects, ongoing since 2024-02
contracts.value: no specific figure (total H1 2026 IP purchases KRW 4,116M)

edges.relationship: Arm CPU/GPU/NPU IP hardened by Gaonchips as an Arm Approved Design Partner

contracts.signal: Gaonchips' half-year report (filed 08-14-2026) states it is an Arm Approved Design Partner (selected 2020-06) and won Arm Design Partner of the Year for 2020, 2021 and 2023; completed R&D projects include Cortex-family Arm CPU IP hardening platforms (2021, 2022) and an automotive Arm CPU in-system-test hardening platform (2023); an ongoing 10Base-T1S zonal automotive processor (2026-04 to 2029-12) includes CPU hardening. No Arm licence amount is disclosed.
contracts.units: Arm IP hardening / design partnership, ongoing since 2020-06
